# kcore_ssh_key (Resource)

SSH public key registered with the controller (`kctl ssh-key add`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kcore_ssh_key" "alice" {
  name       = "alice"
  public_key = "ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIExampleKeyMaterialForDocsOnly alice@workstation"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `public_key` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
